title: Honey Glazed Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: A spicy and flavorful dish from Morocco, perfect for a special occasion or a night out with friends.
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C and heat a robata grill to medium-high heat.
Season the lamb shoulder with salt, black pepper, and ground cumin.
Grill the lamb shoulder for 5 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Transfer the lamb to a Dutch oven or a large clay pot with a lid.
Add the chopped onions, garlic, ginger, and dried spices to the pot.
Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the onions are softened and the spices are fragrant.
Add the honey, lemon juice, and chicken broth to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Let the lamb rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve the lamb in a dolsot stone bowl with the sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with fresh parsley and a sprinkle of sumac.
Adjust seasoning as needed before serving.
